newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Botswana names new central bank governor.
newsitem.headline: Botswana names new central bank governor.

text.p: The Botswana government named on Friday Baledzi Gaolathe as the new Bank of Botswana governor from July 1.
Gaolathe is currently managing director of Debswana - a 50/50 partnership between the Botswana government and South African-based De Beers Consolidated Mines.
The office of President Quett Masire said Gaolathe would replace Quill Hermans who is retiring after 10 years.
Gaolathe was formerly permanent secretary in the finance ministry, a post he held for 15 years, and a board member of the central bank.
"I take the appointment as a challenge and a privilege. I am going there with an open mind, but one always faces such situations with trepidation," he told Reuters.
He said he was unlikely to made any immediate changes to Botswana's monetary or economic policies.

"In the course of time there might be refinements here and there, but basically I cannot deny that for quite a long time. When I was in government I was part of the system and whilst with Debswana I have continued to participate in a different way," Gaolathe said.
